examples: The pond has ice.
Put ice in the drink.
The ice is cold.
Ice covered the pond all winter.

easy.def: An old name for a refrigerator.
examples: The milk is in the icebox.
Grandpa had an icebox.
Put it in the icebox.

more.def: A box or cabinet that was filled with ice to keep food cold, used before refrigerators; also an old name for a refrigerator.
examples: Before electric refrigerators, families kept milk and butter in an icebox filled with ice.
Grandma still calls the refrigerator the icebox.
The milk was kept cold in the icebox.
I drank iced tea.
She had an iced drink.
We ate iced cookies.

more.def: Served very cold with ice, or covered with icing.
examples: She ordered an iced tea on the hot summer day.
He ate an iced cookie with pink frosting.
The iced lemonade was cool and sweet.

easy.def: Covered with ice, or very cold.
examples: The road was icy.
The wind is icy.
An icy pond.

more.def: Covered with ice, or extremely cold.
examples: The icy road made the cars slide.
An icy wind blew across the frozen lake.
She dipped her toes in the icy water and gasped.
